name: White Wind (enemy)
doc: White Wind, the enemy version (Adamantoise's attack): the root and the scene task - the healing wind at the caster and across the party, one sparkle layout per target with its result, the sound. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag226_white_wind.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Scene
parts.doc: The healing wind at the caster and across the party, one sparkle layout per target with its result, the sound
